summary: Two hikers on a Snowmass Mountain summit attempt became trapped on the ridgeline when a rock gave way; one slid ~300 ft down a 60-degree pitch of loose scree and cliff bands at ~13,500 ft, sustaining severe head, chest, back and extremity injuries (multisystem trauma, in and out of consciousness). A Vail Mountain Rescue and Colorado Army National Guard HAATS Black Hawk crew performed a helicopter hoist rescue; the patient was handed off to a Care Flight Critical Care flight team for transport to a Level 1 trauma center, and the hiking partner was also hoisted to safety.
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue; Colorado Army National Guard HAATS; Care Flight Critical Care
notes: Incident described in EMSAC 2022 Award for Valor citation for SAR paramedic Aaron Zinser (Eagle County Paramedics / Vail Mountain Rescue). Distinct from the 2017-08-13 Snowmass west-face lightning/cliffed-out rescue (ids 434, 2196).
